claim: OPay is shutting down its operations in Nigeria next month due to regulatory violations

claim: Third Mainland Bridge closed indefinitely due to structural collapse fear

claim: Dangote Refinery cuts petrol pump price to N300 per litre starting Monday

claim: Ondo State governorship election postponed by 3 weeks due to ballot shortages
